topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I’ve got this to say about your garden idea: I planted borders around my yard for a reason. Those borders aren’t decoration; they mean something. If I start letting folks plant tomatoes and cucumbers over here, next thing you know, my whole yard’s a community project. I’ve got plans for this space, plans that don’t include someone else’s green thumb deciding my landscape. If you need a garden, try a pot or two on your own turf. We’re neighbors, not co-owners.
